gloss: ordinary parents have a gifted child

definitions.gloss: ordinary parents produce an exceptional child
definitions.explanation: Proverb: 'a kite gives birth to a hawk'. The kite is a common, plain bird and the hawk a noble one, so the saying describes a talented child born to unremarkable parents. Often said modestly by the parents themselves or jokingly by others.

examples.japanese: ⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{鳶|とび}が{鷹|たか}を{生|う}んだ⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: A real case of a kite giving birth to a hawk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{鳶|とび}が{鷹|たか}を{生|う}んだようなものだ。
examples.english: My son becoming a doctor is like a kite giving birth to a hawk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両親|りょうしん}→両親：00806_ryoushin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧だが⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧⟦ピアニスト→ピアニスト：19413_pianisuto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{鳶|とび}が{鷹|たか}を{生|う}んだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Her parents are ordinary office workers, but their daughter is a gifted pianist, so people say a kite has given birth to a hawk.

notes:
Also written ⟦{鳶|とび}→鳶：27873_tobi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鷹|たか}→鷹：02218_taka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{産|う}む→産む：01899_umu⟧, and ⟦{鳶|とび}→鳶：27873_tobi⟧ is also read とんび ({鳶|とんび}が{鷹|たか}を{生|う}む). Usually in the past tense or as 〜ようなものだ.

WATCH OUT:
The saying praises the child but runs down the parents, so use it about your own family or in jest; said directly about someone else's parents it can sound rude.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蛙|かえる}の{子|こ}は{蛙|かえる}→蛙の子は蛙：08731_kaerunokohakaeru⟧: like father, like son — the opposite idea
